newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR mostly steady after rate hikes.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR mostly steady after rate hikes.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were mostly steady on Wednesday as traders took a breather after a series of rate increases in reaction to the renewed weakness in the Thai baht, traders said.
Investors were taking swaps, especially with maturities over three months, a banker said.
"They're locking in their funding before rates rise again," a dealer said.
Traders believe domestic rates will further rise since the Thai baht problems are expected to persist some more months.
